issues_detected.title: Condensation on Window
issues_detected.description: Visible condensation between the panes of the double-glazed window, indicating a possible seal failure.
issues_detected.recommendation: Consider replacing the window or repairing the seal to improve energy efficiency and prevent further moisture issues.

analysis.overall_assessment: The window shows signs of condensation, suggesting a seal failure that should be addressed to maintain energy efficiency and prevent potential moisture damage.
